moments.action: Bank lies unconscious in a landfill, face bloodied; a wide shot finds him sprawled on the rubbish slope, and by the last shot he has hauled himself upright, a speck sitting alone on the ridge.
moments.censor_note: dried blood and a swollen, split eye on Bank's face in the opening close-up, which fills the frame; blood smears on his shirt in the wider shots

moments.action: Tight on Bank's muddy shoes picking their way along the rutted track, then the camera pulls back to a wide of him walking off down the dump road with a stray dog standing in his path.
Bank staggers, pitches forward and ends face-down in the mud; by the last shot he is back on his feet, small in the grey haze, walking on under circling birds.

On a school rooftop a classmate in glasses holds forth to Pat, Grace and Lynn. Lynn turns a tiny object over in her fingers while Grace argues back, and by the last shot both girls have gone quiet and are just listening.
The classmate lifts his phone - an insert shows a STIC group chat on screen - and the table leans in. Grace and Lynn crowd the handset, and Pat ends the moment staring at it open-mouthed.
The classmate keeps talking with his eyes shut, pleased with himself; the girls' faces tighten and Lynn puts a hand to her forehead, and he closes the moment grinning straight at them.
Back at the dump, Bank lurches toward camera in tears, turns away up the track, then stops and screams at the sky; the last shot leaves him sitting in the mud, head thrown back, howling.
moments.censor_note: dried blood on Bank's face and the front of his shirt, mid-shot, roughly a quarter of the frame

moments.action: One held take back on the rooftop: Grace fixes the phone with a flat, unsmiling stare while Lynn keeps a hand at her mouth. Nobody speaks or moves - the earlier banter is gone.
